reference_method: Independent Python stdlib analytic integral of the WGS84 surface element between meridians and parallels. Bounds [west,south,east,north]; not calculated using the application or GeographicLib. Short geodesic edges differ slightly from parallels; tolerance covers that distinction and double rounding.

published_geodesic_vector.source: GeographicLib 2.2.0 test/geodesictest.js Planimeter0, non-polar diamond; published lat/lon points converted here to application lon/lat order
